article.title: Benjamin Netanyahu booed at UN General Assembly over Gaza genocide
article.author: Editor
article.content: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faced massive boos and walkouts from diplomats during his speech at the 81st United Nations General Assembly, protesting the ongoing genocide and ethnic cleansing in Gaza. The post Benjamin Netanyahu booed at UN General Assembly over Gaza genocide appeared first on MR Online .
